reference: My name is Ava. I am a student in an English group. This is my notebook. It has a short note. I write my name in it. I have a textbook too. Please open your book, Tom. We can read one name together. A sound is not clear? Please ask me. I can speak again and help you spell it. Then we can check our work with the teacher. Thank you for your help.
